en.headline: Bug report on skipped-role turn merging in openchamber
en.summary: On 2026-10-10, the user opened issue `#4664` in `openchamber/openchamber`, titled "[Bug] A skipped-role notice between two replies merges them into one turn, hiding the earlier finished answer inside Activity", and later added a follow-up comment on the same issue. The issue remains open. A reply was received from `openchamber-bot[bot]`, which marked the report as `fix-ready` and traced the cause to two pieces on current `main`, including grouping logic in `packages/ui/src/components/chat/lib/turns/projectTurnRecords.ts:244-246`. No pull requests, reviews, releases, stars, or discussions were recorded. The user made **0 own commits**, with 14 automated commits by `github-actions[bot]` in `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`.
